title: Stage and member binding
summary: Sessions walk shared QA groups concurrently; a member whose owed groups are all held retains its claim and parks. Failed QA recovery rereads remaining blockers and run/stage/member/target evidence. Item-form QA (--item --stage) resolves to the live run whose open member rows sit at that stage, takeover successors included and shared memberless rows excluded; with no rows yet each case's own target_envs picks the run. Several qualifying runs refuse with each listed, the holder names one with --deployment-run-id, and a live run holding the rows before the stage is named to wait on instead of a new deployment. A cleared dependency cannot change the old frozen target; a correction outside that lineage requires a qualifying later deployed candidate. Case target_envs selects registered environments independently of optional stage_reason metadata; every target retains its own immutable obligation and acceptance evidence. Deployment case identity follows durable correction links across plans and receipt changes within each subject and shared group. The newest chain end decides work; passed cases keep their frozen definitions while unpassed cases can be corrected independently.
